name: Qwen-Agent
description: Alibaba's agent framework for Qwen models that ships example apps such as a browser assistant and code interpreter.
whatItDoes: Developers use it to build assistants with tool calling, planning, memory and RAG, and can launch the bundled example agents with a Gradio UI.
howItWorks: Agents wrap a Qwen model served by DashScope or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with function calling, a code-interpreter tool, document retrieval and MCP tool support.

requirements.name: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
requirements.description: Alibaba Cloud DashScope key; not needed with a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server

models: Qwen models via DashScope or OpenAI-compatible servers
